title: Seetha's reply to Ogres
introduction: Seetha cites the examples of Sachi, Arundhati, Rohini et.al., on their devotion towards their husbands. Ogre women threaten to kill Seetha and eat her.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुर्विंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 24th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः |
परुषं परुषा नार्य ऊचुस्तां वाक्यमप्रियम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sītāmupāgamya rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ |
paruṣaṃ paruṣā nārya Ucustāṃ vākyamapriyam
verses.translation: Thereafter ogre women with a cruel nature, with crooked faces neared that Seetha and spoke unpleasant words harshly.

verses.devanagari:
किं त्वमन्तःपुरे सीते सर्वभूतमनोहरे |
महार्हशयनोपेते न वासमनुमन्यसे
verses.iast:
kiṃ tvamantaḥpure sīte sarvabhūtamanohare |
mahārhaśayanopete na vāsamanumanyase
verses.translation: "O Seetha! Why are you not agreeing to stay in the gynaeceum pleasing to all beings together with very best beds."

glosses.meaning: together with the very best beds.

verses.devanagari:
मानुषी मानुषस्यैव भार्यात्वं बहुमन्यसे |
प्रत्याहर मनो रामान्न त्वं जातु भविष्यसि
verses.iast:
mānuṣī mānuṣasyaiva bhāryātvaṃ bahumanyase |
pratyāhara mano rāmānna tvaṃ jātu bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: "You who are a human are thinking highly about the wifehood of a human being. Withdraw your mind from Rama. Otherwise you will not exist at all."

verses.devanagari:
त्रैलोक्यवसुभोक्तारं रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् |
भर्तारमुपसंगम्य विहरस्व यथासुखम्
verses.iast:
trailokyavasubhoktāraṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣaseśvaram |
bhartāramupasaṅgamya viharasva yathāsukham
verses.translation: "Sport according to your comfort coming together with the king of ogres Ravana enjoying luxuries of the three worlds and taking him as husband.

glosses.meaning: enjoying luxuries of the three worlds

verses.devanagari:
मानुषी मानुषं तं तु राममिच्छसि शोभने |
राज्याद्भ्राष्टमसिद्धार्थं विक्लबं त्वमनिन्दिते
verses.iast:
mānuṣī mānuṣaṃ taṃ tu rāmamicchasi śobhane |
rājyādbhrāṣṭamasiddhārthaṃ viklabaṃ tvamanindite
verses.translation: "O beautiful one! O irrreproachable one! But being a human you are desiring that Rama who is a human, banished from kingdom, unsuccessful and gloomy."

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसीनां वचः श्रुत्वा सीता पद्मनिभेक्षणा |
नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
rākṣasīnāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā sītā padmanibhekṣaṇā |
netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: Seetha with eyes like lotuses hearing the words of ogre women spoke these words with eyes filled with tears.

verses.devanagari:
यदिदम् लोकविद्विष्टमुदाहरथ संगताः |
नैतन्मनसि वाक्यं मे किल्बिषं प्रतिभाति वः
verses.iast:
yadidam lokavidviṣṭamudāharatha saṅgatāḥ |
naitanmanasi vākyaṃ me kilbiṣaṃ pratibhāti vaḥ
verses.translation: "All of you coming together whatever words which are hated in the world you spoke in my matter, this does it not seem sinful in your mind?"

glosses.meaning: which are hated in the world

verses.devanagari:
न मानुषी राक्षसस्य भार्या भवितुमर्हति |
कामं खादत मां सर्वा न करिष्यामि वो वचः
verses.iast:
na mānuṣī rākṣasasya bhāryā bhavitumarhati |
kāmaṃ khādata māṃ sarvā na kariṣyāmi vo vacaḥ
verses.translation: "Human woman is not waited to become wife of an ogre. All of you freely eat me. I will not honour your words."

verses.devanagari:
दीनो वा राज्यहीनो वा यो मे भर्ता स मे गुरुः |
तं नित्यमनुरक्तास्मि यथा सूर्यं सुवर्चला
verses.iast:
dīno vā rājyahīno vā yo me bhartā sa me guruḥ |
taṃ nityamanuraktāsmi yathā sūryaṃ suvarcalā
verses.translation: "Although wretched or without kingdom, whoever is my husband, He alone is my master. Like Suvarchala with the Sun God, I am fond of Him always."

verses.devanagari:
यथा शची महाभागा शक्रं समुपतिष्ठति |
अरुन्धती वसिष्ठं च रोहिणी शशिनं यथा
लोपामुद्रा यथागस्त्यं सुकन्याच्यवनं यथा |
सावित्री सत्यवन्तं च कपिलं श्रीमती यथा
सौदासं मदयन्तीव केशिनी सगरं यथा |
नैषधं दमयन्तीव भैमी पतिमनुव्रता
तथाहमिक्ष्वाकुवरं रामं पतिमनुव्रता |
verses.iast:
yathā śacī mahābhāgā śakraṃ samupatiṣṭhati |
arundhatī vasiṣṭhaṃ ca rohiṇī śaśinaṃ yathā
lopāmudrā yathāgastyaṃ sukanyācyavanaṃ yathā |
sāvitrī satyavantaṃ ca kapilaṃ śrīmatī yathā
saudāsaṃ madayantīva keśinī sagaraṃ yathā |
naiṣadhaṃ damayantīva bhaimī patimanuvratā
tathāhamikṣvākuvaraṃ rāmaṃ patimanuvratā |
verses.translation: "Like the highly fortunate Sachi who waits upon Indra, like Arundhati on Vasishta, like Rohini on the Moon God, like Lopamudra on Agastya, like Sukanya on Chyavana, like Savitri on Satyavanta, like Srimati on Kapila, like Madayanti on Saudasa, like Kesini on Sagara, like Damayanti the daughter of Bhima, devoted to husband Nala, in the same way I am devoted to my husband Rama, the best in Ikshvaku dynasty."

verses.devanagari:
सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्चिताः
भर्त्सयन्ति स्म परुषैर्वाक्यै रावणचोदिताः |
verses.iast:
sītāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā rākṣasyaḥ krodhamūrcitāḥ
bhartsayanti sma paruṣairvākyai rāvaṇacoditāḥ |
verses.translation: Ogre women incited by Ravana listening to the words of Seetha, swooned with anger and frightened Her with harsh words.

verses.devanagari:
अवलीनः स निर्वाक्यो हनुमान् शिंशुपाद्रुमे
सीतां संतर्जयन्तीस्ता राक्ससीरशृणोत् कपिः |
verses.iast:
avalīnaḥ sa nirvākyo hanumān śiṃśupādrume
sītāṃ santarjayantīstā rāksasīraśṛṇot kapiḥ |
verses.translation: That monkey Hanuma not talking and hiding in the Simsupa tree listened to those ogre women frightening Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
तामभिक्रम्य संक्रुद्दा वेपमानां समन्ततः
भृशं संलिलिहुर्दीप्तान् प्रलब्मन् दशनच्छदान् |
verses.iast:
tāmabhikramya saṅkruddā vepamānāṃ samantataḥ
bhṛśaṃ saṃlilihurdīptān pralabman daśanacchadān |
verses.translation: Nearing that Seetha shaking with fear in all directions, those ogres being angry licked a lot shining and hanging lips.

verses.devanagari:
ऊचुश्च परमक्रुद्धाः प्रगृह्याशु परश्वधान्
नेयमर्हति भर्तारं रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् |
verses.iast:
Ucuśca paramakruddhāḥ pragṛhyāśu paraśvadhān
neyamarhati bhartāraṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam |
verses.translation: Being angry a lot and grasping axes quickly spoke as follows: "This woman is not suited to have the king of ogres Ravana as husband."

verses.devanagari:
सा भर्तस्यमाना भीमाभी राक्षसीभिर्वरानना
सबाष्पमपसर्पन्ती शिंशुपां तामुपागमत् |
verses.iast:
sā bhartasyamānā bhīmābhī rākṣasībhirvarānanā
sabāṣpamapasarpantī śiṃśupāṃ tāmupāgamat |
verses.translation: Being frightened by ogre women who were horrible that Seetha with best face with tears in eyes and moving from there reached that Simsupa tree.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तां शिंशुपां सीता राक्षसीभिः समावृता
अभिगम्य विशालाक्षी तस्थौ शोकपरिप्लुता |
verses.iast:
tatastāṃ śiṃśupāṃ sītā rākṣasībhiḥ samāvṛtā
abhigamya viśālākṣī tasthau śokapariplutā |
verses.translation: Thereafter the wide eyed Seetha nearing that Simsupa tree being surrounded by ogre women was situated there with gloom.

verses.devanagari:
तां कृशां दीनवदनां मलिनाम्बरधारिणीम्
भर्त्सयांचक्रिरे सीतां राक्षस्यस्ताम् समन्ततः |
verses.iast:
tāṃ kṛśāṃ dīnavadanāṃ malināmbaradhāriṇīm
bhartsayāñcakrire sītāṃ rākṣasyastām samantataḥ |
verses.translation: Those ogres frightened from all directions that Seetha who was emaciated with a pitiful face and wearing dirty garments.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तां विनता नाम राक्षसी भीमदर्शना
अब्रवीत्कुपिताकारा कराळा निर्णतोदरी |
verses.iast:
tatastāṃ vinatā nāma rākṣasī bhīmadarśanā
abravītkupitākārā karāLā nirṇatodarī |
verses.translation: Thereafter an ogre woman named Vinata with a horrible appearance with an angry form, crooked, having a prominent belly spoke to Her.

verses.devanagari:
सीते पर्याप्तमेतावद्भर्तुः स्नेहो निदर्शितः
सर्वात्रातिकृतं भद्रे व्यसनायोपकल्पते |
verses.iast:
sīte paryāptametāvadbhartuḥ sneho nidarśitaḥ
sarvātrātikṛtaṃ bhadre vyasanāyopakalpate |
verses.translation: "O Seetha! You have showed love of husband. This much is enough. O auspicious one! At all times doing something excessively serves as vice."

verses.devanagari:
परितुष्टास्मि भद्रं ते मानुषस्ते कृतो विधिः
ममापि तु वचः पथ्यं ब्रुवन्त्याः कुरु मैथिलि |
verses.iast:
parituṣṭāsmi bhadraṃ te mānuṣaste kṛto vidhiḥ
mamāpi tu vacaḥ pathyaṃ bruvantyāḥ kuru maithili |
verses.translation: "O Seetha! I am happy. Human duty has been done by you. Let there be fortune to you. Do also according to my wholesome words being told."

glosses.meaning: O Seetha! paritushhTaa asmi = I am happy

verses.devanagari:
रावणं भ्ज भर्तारं भर्तारं सर्वरक्षसाम्
विक्रान्तं रूपवन्तं च सुरेशमिव वासवम् |
दक्षिणं त्यागशीलं च सर्वस्य प्रियदर्शनम्
verses.iast:
rāvaṇaṃ bhja bhartāraṃ bhartāraṃ sarvarakṣasām
vikrāntaṃ rūpavantaṃ ca sureśamiva vāsavam |
dakṣiṇaṃ tyāgaśīlaṃ ca sarvasya priyadarśanam
verses.translation: "Obtain as husband Ravana who is the lord of al l ogres, bold and handsome, like Indra the lord of Devas, able one and liberal with a pleasing appearance to all."

verses.devanagari:
मानुषं कृपणं रामं त्यक्त्वा रावणमाश्रय |
दिव्याङ्गरागा वैदेहि दिव्याभरणभूषिता
अद्यप्रभृति सर्वेषां लोकनामीश्वरी भव |
verses.iast:
mānuṣaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ rāmaṃ tyaktvā rāvaṇamāśraya |
divyāṇ^garāgā vaidehi divyābharaṇabhūṣitā
adyaprabhṛti sarveṣāṃ lokanāmīśvarī bhava |
verses.translation: "Leaving Rama who is a human and miserable, seek refuge in Ravana. O Seetha! With best unguents to the body and decorated with best ornaments, become mistress of all the worlds from today."

glosses.meaning: with best unguents to the body

verses.devanagari:
अग्नेः स्वाहा यथा देवी शिची वेन्द्रस्य शोभने
किं ते रामेण वैदेहि कृपणेन गतायिषा |
verses.iast:
agneḥ svāhā yathā devī śicī vendrasya śobhane
kiṃ te rāmeṇa vaidehi kṛpaṇena gatāyiṣā |
verses.translation: "O auspicious one! Like Svaha the wife of the Fire God, like Sachi the wife of Indra become mistress of all worlds. O Seetha! What is the use with Rama who is miserable and with gone vigour."

glosses.meaning: (wife) of Indra (become mistress of all worlds

verses.devanagari:
एतदुक्तं च मे वाक्यं यदि त्वं न करिष्यपि
अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते सर्वास्त्वां भक्षयिष्यामहे वयम् |
verses.iast:
etaduktaṃ ca me vākyaṃ yadi tvaṃ na kariṣyapi
asminmuhūrte sarvāstvāṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmahe vayam |
verses.translation: If you do not do my this spoken word, all of us in this moment will eat you.

verses.devanagari:
अन्या तु विकटा नाम लबमानपयोधरा
अब्रवीत्कुपिता सीतां मुष्टिमुद्यम्य गर्जती |
verses.iast:
anyā tu vikaṭā nāma labamānapayodharā
abravītkupitā sītāṃ muṣṭimudyamya garjatī |
verses.translation: Another ogre named Vikata with hanging breasts raising fist and roaring with anger spoke to Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
बहून्य्प्रियरूपाणि वचनानि सुदुर्मते
अनुक्रोशान्मऋदुत्वाच्च सोढानि तव मैथिलि |
verses.iast:
bahUnypriyarūpāṇi vacanāni sudurmate
anukrośānmaṛdutvācca soḍhāni tava maithili |
verses.translation: "O Seetha with an evil mind! Your many words which are unpleasant have been tolerated due to pity and due to softness."

verses.devanagari:
न च नः कुरुषे वाक्यं हितं कालपुरुस्कृतम्
अनीतासि समुद्रस्य पारमन्यैर्दुरासदम् |
रावणान्तःपुरं घोरं प्रविष्टा चासि मैथिलि
verses.iast:
na ca naḥ kuruṣe vākyaṃ hitaṃ kālapuruskṛtam
anītāsi samudrasya pāramanyairdurāsadam |
rāvaṇāntaḥpuraṃ ghoraṃ praviṣṭā cāsi maithili
verses.translation: "O Seetha! You are not doing according to our word which is respected by time and wholesome. You have been brought to this bank of the ocean not obtainable by others. You have entered the terrible gynaeceum of Ravana."

verses.devanagari:
रावणस्य गृहे रुद्धामस्माभिस्तु सुरक्षिताम् |
न त्वां शक्तः परित्रातुमपि साक्षात्पुरन्दरः
verses.iast:
rāvaṇasya gṛhe ruddhāmasmābhistu surakṣitām |
na tvāṃ śaktaḥ paritrātumapi sākṣātpurandaraḥ
verses.translation: "Withheld in the house of Ravana well protected by us, even Devendra himself is not capable to protect you."

verses.devanagari:
कुरुष्व हितवादिन्या वचनं मम मैथिलि |
अलमश्रुप्रपातेन त्यज शोकमन्र्थकम्
verses.iast:
kuruṣva hitavādinyā vacanaṃ mama maithili |
alamaśruprapātena tyaja śokamanrthakam
verses.translation: "O Seetha! Do according to my word, which is beneficial. Discharge of tears is enough. Leave worthless gloom."

verses.devanagari:
भज प्रीतिं च हर्षं च त्यजैतां नित्यदैन्यताम् |
सीते राक्षसराजेन सह क्रीड यथासुखम्
verses.iast:
bhaja prītiṃ ca harṣaṃ ca tyajaitāṃ nityadainyatām |
sīte rākṣasarājena saha krīḍa yathāsukham
verses.translation: "O Seetha! Have love and happiness. Leave this daily gloom. Sport according to comfort with the king of ogres."

verses.devanagari:
जानासि हि यथा भीरु स्त्रीणां यौवनमध्रुवम् |
यावन्न ते व्यतिक्रामेत्तावत्सुखमवाप्नुहि
verses.iast:
jānāsi hi yathā bhīru strīṇāṃ yauvanamadhruvam |
yāvanna te vyatikrāmettāvatsukhamavāpnuhi
verses.translation: "O timid one! You know how youth of women is not lasting. As long as your youth will not pass away, so long get comfort."

verses.devanagari:
उद्यानानि च रम्याणि पर्वतोपवनानि च |
सह राक्षसराजेन चर त्वं मदिरेक्षणे
verses.iast:
udyānāni ca ramyāṇi parvatopavanāni ca |
saha rākṣasarājena cara tvaṃ madirekṣaṇe
verses.translation: "O one with intoxicating eyes! You along with king of ogres roam beautiful groves, mountains and nearby forests.

verses.devanagari:
स्त्रीसहस्राणि ते सप्त वशे स्थास्यन्ति सुन्दरि |
रावणं भज भर्तारं भ्र्तारं सर्वरक्षसाम्
verses.iast:
strīsahasrāṇi te sapta vaśe sthāsyanti sundari |
rāvaṇaṃ bhaja bhartāraṃ bhrtāraṃ sarvarakṣasām
verses.translation: "O beautiful one! seven thousand women will be in your control. Have as husband Ravana the lord of all ogres."

verses.devanagari:
उत्पाट्य वा ते हृदयं भक्षयिष्यामि मैथिलि |
यदि मे व्याहृतं वाक्यं न यथावत्करिष्यसि
verses.iast:
utpāṭya vā te hṛdayaṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmi maithili |
yadi me vyāhṛtaṃ vākyaṃ na yathāvatkariṣyasi
verses.translation: "O Seetha! If you do not do according to my spoken word as is, I will eat your heart indeed by plucking it out."

verses.devanagari:
ततश्चण्डोदरी नाम राक्षसी क्रोधमूर्छिता |
भ्रामयन्ती महच्चूलमिदं वचनम्ब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tataścaṇḍodarī nāma rākṣasī krodhamUrchitā |
bhrāmayantī mahaccūlamidaṃ vacanambravīt
verses.translation: Thereafter an ogre woman named Chandodari swooning with anger, turning around a big spike spoke this word.

verses.devanagari:
इमां हरिणलोलाक्षीं त्रासोत्कम्पिपयोधरां |
रावणेन हृतां दृष्ट्वा दौहृदो मे महानभूत्
verses.iast:
imāṃ hariṇalolākṣīṃ trāsotkampipayodharāṃ |
rāvaṇena hṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā dauhṛdo me mahānabhūt
verses.translation: "Seeing this woman with eyes like that of a deer, with moving breasts due to fear, abducted by Ravana, there occured to me a great desire."

glosses.meaning: with eyes like that of a deer
with moving breasts due to fear

verses.devanagari:
यकृत्ल्पीहमथोत्पीडं हृदयं च सबन्धनम् |
अन्त्राण्यपि तथा शीर्षं खादेयमिति मे मतिः
verses.iast:
yakṛtlpīhamathotpīḍaṃ hṛdayaṃ ca sabandhanam |
antrāṇyapi tathā śīrṣaṃ khādeyamiti me matiḥ
verses.translation: "It is my mind to eat the liver, the spleen, flesh above heart and heart together with muscle and entrails and the head."

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु प्रघसा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् |
कण्ठमस्या नृशंसायाः पीडयाम किमास्यते
verses.iast:
tatastu praghasā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt |
kaṇṭhamasyā nṛśaṃsāyāḥ pīḍayāma kimāsyate
verses.translation: An ogre woman named Pragasa spoke these words : "Squeeze the neck of this cruel woman. Why do we delay?"

verses.devanagari:
निवेद्यतां ततो राज्ञे मानुषी सा मृतेति ह |
नात्र कश्चन संदेहः खादतेति स वक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
nivedyatāṃ tato rājJṇe mānuṣī sā mṛteti ha |
nātra kaścana sandehaḥ khādateti sa vakṣyati
verses.translation: "Thereafter let it be known to the king that that human woman has died. He will say thus : "Eat.". There is no doubt in this matter."

verses.devanagari:
ततस्त्वजामुखी नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् |
विशस्येमां ततः सर्वाः समान् कुरुत पीलुकान्
verses.iast:
tatastvajāmukhī nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt |
viśasyemāṃ tataḥ sarvāḥ samān kuruta pīlukān
verses.translation: Thereafter an ogre woman named Ajamukhi spoke these words : "All of you killing this woman thereafter do equal pieces."

verses.devanagari:
विभजाम ततः सर्वा विवादो मे न रोचते |
पेयमानीयतां क्षिप्रं लेह्यमुच्चावचं बहु
verses.iast:
vibhajāma tataḥ sarvā vivādo me na rocate |
peyamānīyatāṃ kṣipraṃ lehyamuccāvacaṃ bahu
verses.translation: "Thereafter all of us will divide. Quarrel is not desirable to me. Liquor, many kinds and a lot of lickables be brought quickly."

verses.devanagari:
ततः शूर्पणखा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् |
अजामुख्या यदुक्तं हि तदेव मम रोचते
verses.iast:
tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt |
ajāmukhyā yaduktaṃ hi tadeva mama rocate
verses.translation: Thereafter an ogre woman named Surpanakha spoke these words: "That which was spoken by Ajamukhi, is desirable to me."

verses.devanagari:
सुरा चानीयतां क्षिप्रं सर्वशोकविनाशिनी |
मानुषं मां समास्वाद्य नृत्यामोथ निकुम्भिलाम्
verses.iast:
surā cānīyatāṃ kṣipraṃ sarvaśokavināśinī |
mānuṣaṃ māṃ samāsvādya nṛtyāmotha nikumbhilām
verses.translation: "Liquor which is the destroyer of all sorrow be brought quickly. Eating human flesh afterwards, we will dance for propitiating Nikumbila."

glosses.meaning: (which is the) destroyer of all sorrow

verses.devanagari:
एवं संभर्त्स्यमाना सा सीता सुरसुतोपमा |
राक्षसीभिः सुघोराभिर्धैर्यमुत्सृज्य रोदिति
verses.iast:
evaṃ sambhartsyamānā sā sītā surasutopamā |
rākṣasībhiḥ sughorābhirdhairyamutsṛjya roditi
verses.translation: Thus being frightened by horrible ogres, that Seetha equalling a daughter of gods, abandoning fortitude, was crying.
